title: Irreducible binary monic polynomial
statement: For every positive integer $\\ell$, there is a polynomial over $\\mathbb{F}_2$ of the form $X^\\ell+\\sum_{i=0}^{\\ell-1}a_iX^i$, with coefficients $a_i\\in\\mathbb{F}_2$, that is irreducible.
